values.binNote: No bin row carries the underway-eruption knock up duration; NautilusGrandLine.StunDuration covers the stun, but the 1 second knock up on non-final eruptions is not separately exposed in the sheet.

mechanics.claim: The Depth Charge creates damaging eruptions periodically as it chases the target, not one instance.
mechanics.quote: creating eruptions every {{rutngt|0.25}} in its wake

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit by non-final eruptions are knocked up and stunned; the final eruption at the primary target deals increased damage.
mechanics.quote: Upon reaching the primary target, the ''Depth Charge'' erupts a final time at their location. The primary target takes increased damage

mechanics.claim: The final eruption's knock up duration is modified (implied same as stun duration by rank, not the 1 second base of underway eruptions).
mechanics.quote: airborne|knocked up}} for a modified duration

mechanics.claim: Enemies far enough away from the charge/eruption are knocked back instead of up; this does not change damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies a certain distance away from the charge / eruption are instead {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.

mechanics.claim: Depth Charge keeps chasing even if the target dies or becomes untargetable.
mechanics.quote: ''Depth Charge'' will not stop chasing if the target dies or becomes untargetable.
